programmes.evidence: Current school overview explicitly has this doctoral discipline; 2026 doctoral admission rules directly admit in Management Science and Engineering 120100. Official English overview names same doctoral discipline and school PhD navigation supports English equivalent. Exact Chinese generic doctoral credential retained without inventing a specific diploma category or a separate OR/IE doctorate.

researchDoctorateEvidence.evidence: University degree-award rules effective 2025 distinguish academic doctoral research and professional practice; academic doctoral candidates must independently conduct academic research and produce innovative research, with independent thesis/results and expert review/public doctoral defence. School current doctoral discipline and research-oriented admission provide programme linkage; exact category-specific diploma wording not established.

limitations: No separate Operations/Industrial Engineering doctoral award or programme-to-department allocation inferred from undergraduate department research or courses.

2026 special plan is part-time targeted admission, not a universal mode assertion. Exact category-specific diploma wording remains unknown; displayed generic博士学位 is not silently converted into a literal Doctor of Philosophy diploma title.
